verdict.rationale: Fly.io's core architecture is hardware-isolated Fly Machines/VMs (not a restricted edge sandbox), which implies developers can run full unmodified Node.js apps and npm dependencies rather than a limited runtime subset, and flyctl/launch docs support deploying arbitrary containerized code. However, the evidence pack contains no explicit confirmation of Node.js or npm package compatibility, no direct comparison to 'restricted runtime subset' edge platforms, and no hands-on account of running an unmodified Node app with native npm modules. missing for 10: explicit Node.js/npm support documentation, direct contrast with restricted edge runtimes, and independent verification of unmodified npm package execution.
